requirements.general_text: PhD Eligibility Criteria Degree Requirements: A good master’s degree (usually merit or higher). An upper second-class honours degree (2:1) or international equivalent in a relevant discipline. Non-UK qualifications will be assessed. Language Proficiency (if applicable): IELTS (Academic): Overall 7.0, with no component below 6.0. TOEFL iBT: Overall 100, with minimum scores: Writing & Listening: 19 Reading: 20 Speaking: 22 PTE (Academic): Overall 76, with no component below 65. MUET: Band 5 (valid for 5 years). Important Notes: English proficiency test results must be less than 2 years old. IELTS One Skill Retake is accepted. Online versions of IELTS, TOEFL, or PTE are not accepted.
